liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **I Wonder Where Our Love Has Gone (a cappella)**: rare: 5 archived performances [7]
- **Alpha Double Negative: Going to Catalina**: back after 34 archived shows (960 days); rare: 12 archived performances [7]
- **Alpha Desperation March**: rare: 6 archived performances [7]
- **Encore thing with Uno and Cheaters skit**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Dinu Lipatti's Bones, Old College Try, Game Shows Touch Our Lives [7]

## The recordings

- **tmg2005-06-18.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 62 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Opening minute is marred by mic-adjustment rumble that stops at one minute; taper reports no other major recording problems; Reviewer finds the taping badly planned and executed, ruining a show that could have been excellent; Reviewer calls the 64Kbps encoding poor quality [1][3][4][5][6]

## Around the show

- Clipper is tiny, has a train-car-like separate dining room, sits near punk, metal and hip-hop clubs, and serves Pabst on tap or canned [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **tmg2005-06-18.flac16**: taped by mycarrion; source: sp-cmc2's>sp-spsb-1(ro@95hz)>njb3>usb>hd>nero5.0>cdwave>flac [1]. Also: Reviewer says they made the original recording; the 64Kbps copy was posted publicly without their consent; Taped by mycarrion, described as one of the best tapers in the area; The recording was made by mycarrion [4][5][6]
